objects.description: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) has hosted malicious payloads on DropBox including [PlugX](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0013).(Citation: Proofpoint TA416 Europe March 2022)
objects.description_fa: [Mustang Panda](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0129) بارهای مخربی را در DropBox میزبانی کرده است، از جمله [PlugX](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0013).(Citation: Proofpoint TA416 Europe March 2022)
